responseFormatConfig.description: Configuration for the response output format. This is a flat object where each optional sub-field configures a specific output modality.

mimeType.description: Optional. The MIME type of the text output.
enumDescriptions: Default value. This value is unused.

schema.description: Optional. The JSON schema that the output should conform to. Only applicable when mime_type is APPLICATION_JSON.

documentationMismatch: Official guide uses application/json; live HTTP400 and current discovery require APPLICATION_JSON enum. No runtime API change until a live output passes.
